music.reason: No external music needed; no generated music or voice.

shots.title: The fork
shots.requiredPicture: Open on the accepted fork-shaped junction. If no junction passes, use the two power routes at court.
shots.soundDirection: One clean impact. Start on picture; no opening logo delay.

shots.title: Welcome to FORK
shots.requiredPicture: Separate title card, one quick type reveal.
shots.soundDirection: Title lands on the beat.

shots.title: Your own Singapore
shots.requiredPicture: Short pullout through loaded scenery, then a title with the actual playable-area subtitle.
shots.soundDirection: Two concise camera views if the existing path is unreliable.

shots.title: Find our neighbourhood
shots.requiredPicture: Explicit cut to the attributed static Singapore locator and accepted court marker.
shots.soundDirection: Keep source credit readable. The map is an overview, not generated coverage.

shots.title: Meet the medic
shots.requiredPicture: Enter the real clinic and end on the medic.
shots.soundDirection: Doorstep and room sound from the game.

shots.title: Meet the engineer
shots.requiredPicture: Cut to the engineer and workshop repair indicator.
shots.soundDirection: Match the camera direction; no new character animation.

shots.title: Meet the courier
shots.requiredPicture: Courier and spare battery; one short role label.
shots.soundDirection: Small percussive accent.

shots.title: The dilemma
shots.requiredPicture: Show the initial checkpoint, two total charges, and the clinic/workshop power choice.
shots.soundDirection: Duck the track for the choice. Keep all relevant values legible.

shots.title: Choose clinic
shots.requiredPicture: Real clinic allocation input and acknowledgement. Retain the actual runtime-mode label.
shots.soundDirection: Use the actual click and response.

shots.title: Branch A moves
shots.requiredPicture: Condense the committed rounds in order. Show round numbers and a waits-trimmed label.
shots.soundDirection: Cut on round commits; never animate an invented result.

shots.title: Branch A result
shots.requiredPicture: Hold the real round-six result: clinic service and repair progress.
shots.soundDirection: Four seconds without a transition over the values.

shots.title: Rewind
shots.requiredPicture: Actual rewind control, then its forward-playing restore footage.
shots.soundDirection: Brief reverse sound and music stop. The effect punctuates the real action.

shots.title: Same starting point
shots.requiredPicture: Hold the verified initial round, both charges and restored court. Label a checkpoint reload if that is the accepted method.
shots.soundDirection: Music returns. Trim a long wait with a clear elapsed-time cue.

shots.title: Choose workshop
shots.requiredPicture: Real workshop allocation and the beginning of branch B.
shots.soundDirection: Return to the same camera angle as the first choice.

shots.title: The spare arrives
shots.requiredPicture: Real committed courier delivery and repair progress, in their actual round order.
shots.soundDirection: If live actions differ, show the accepted run and use the alternative narration.

shots.title: The cost
shots.requiredPicture: Hold the real clinic outage if it occurs. Otherwise show the actual round-three status.
shots.soundDirection: Brief musical dip; the consequence gets a clear beat.

shots.title: Grid online
shots.requiredPicture: Show the actual grid activation and powered buildings, if the accepted run achieves it.
shots.soundDirection: One satisfying rise. A different live outcome gets its real status instead.

shots.title: Branch B result
shots.requiredPicture: Hold the real round-six result.
shots.soundDirection: Four seconds to read the outcome.

shots.title: Two futures
shots.requiredPicture: Use the real equal-round comparison for all ten seconds. Keep the final six seconds visually still and the final two seconds without narration.
shots.soundDirection: Music lowers. Let the viewer read the tradeoff.

shots.title: Inspect a decision
shots.requiredPicture: Show one real committed role proposal and effect in the inspector.
shots.soundDirection: A precise crop is allowed; preserve the meaning and mode label.

shots.title: Play
shots.requiredPicture: Three two-second shots of accepted features: clinic interior, visit/return if proven, and courier or workshop. Default to existing court views when extras are absent.
shots.soundDirection: A separately captured paused facade effect plus restore may replace this whole block only if already accepted. Never add a feature for this shot.

shots.title: How Astra helped
shots.requiredPicture: Two separate three-second cards: actual new Astra-authored work with a readable evidence excerpt, then the reused Agent Arena foundation. Remove private information.
shots.soundDirection: Credit the actual development model and contributions. Keep the distinction readable.

shots.title: Choose a future
shots.requiredPicture: FORK, the real GitHub route, Minecraft Java requirement, and compact unofficial notice. Put full notices in the repository and video description.
shots.soundDirection: Resolve the music and hold the final card. The judge must be able to access the linked repository.

voice.text: A fork in the road. Welcome to FORK. Your own Singapore.
One neighbourhood. A medic, an engineer, a courier. And one generator.
Two batteries. Two choices. Let's go.
Power the clinic. Six rounds of service. The lights stay on. Repairs remain zero.
Rewind. Same starting point. Same two charges. Try again.
Power the workshop. The courier delivers the spare. Repairs progress.
One round without clinic power. Then the grid comes online. Both buildings powered.
Same start. Six rounds. Two different futures. Keep the clinic on, or restore the grid with a cost.
See what each role actually changed.
Built with Astra. New rules, rewind and comparison. Agent Arena underneath.
FORK. Choose a future. Code on GitHub.
